promises.statement: H2 will be better than H1 and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4.
promises.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO and MD
promises.actual: Latest reported Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth is 6.5%
promises.verdict: Pending until Q4 FY27 results are reported.

promises.statement: Solutions and products growth is expected to be 30% plus.
promises.quote: First is faster growth with solution products. We believe this growth, we expect to be 30% on this, even though it's a small part, as we said, initially we start with 20 25%. We'll grow with 30% plus growth rate in these solutions and products
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: Solutions and products growth breakdown not reported in financial numbers
promises.verdict: Segmental solutions/products growth percentage is not published in reported financials.

promises.statement: We will be able to hold on to our EBITDA in the immediate future and increase margins in the mid-term.
promises.quote: And we have provide directionally that We'll be able to hold on to our EBITDA in the immediate future. In spite of the headwinds, we'll capitalize on the tailwinds that we have, but more importantly, in the midterm, we want to increase our margins.
promises.speaker: Sachin Tikekar, President and Joint MD
promises.actual: EBITDA margin dropped to 15.0% in Jun 2026 and 16.0% in Sep 2026
promises.verdict: Immediate EBITDA margins declined rather than holding; mid-term target remains pending.

promises.statement: We will grow next year higher than this year.
promises.quote: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year. And we believe that we will be in a position to do it.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: TTM revenue growth is 3.7% compared to 10.5% in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: FY27 results are pending; current trajectory is trailing FY26 full-year growth.

promises.statement: Our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.
promises.quote: our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: Reported Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin was 20.8% (or 18% in financials) vs 19% in Q3 FY26
promises.verdict: Profitability improved in Q4 FY26 over Q3 FY26 as promised.

promises.statement: In the last quarter that is Q4, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
promises.quote: we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: Revenue QoQ growth was 5.8% in Mar 2026 (Q4 FY26), highest in FY26
promises.verdict: Q4 FY26 registered the highest quarterly QoQ revenue growth of the fiscal year.

promises.statement: Maintain 21% EBITDA margin for the full year despite salary increments.
promises.quote: And we are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin was 19.0%
promises.verdict: Missed the target of 21% EBITDA margin for FY26 by 200 bps.

promises.statement: Quarter 3 will have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth.
promises.quote: We believe that in the Quarter 3, we will be in a position to have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: Constant currency growth was 0.4% in Q3 FY26 (Dec 2025 per call text)
promises.verdict: Achieved positive constant currency growth in Q3 FY26.

promises.statement: Quarter 4 will see meaningful growth coming in.
promises.quote: In terms of Quarter 4, we do believe that there will be a meaningful growth, which will be coming in.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: QoQ revenue growth accelerated to 5.8% in Mar 2026
promises.verdict: Delivered meaningful growth acceleration in Q4 FY26.

promises.statement: We believe we can maintain the EBITDA margins at 21% in the foreseeable future.
promises.quote: Right now, I would say, in a foreseeable future, we believe we can maintain the margins at 21%.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO and MD
promises.actual: EBITDA margins dropped to 19.0% in FY26 and 15.0%-16.0% in Q1/Q2 FY27
promises.verdict: Failed to sustain 21% EBITDA margin, falling to 15-16% levels in FY27.

promises.statement: India and China together will be a 3-digit number in terms of revenues in 2 years.
promises.quote: I will not give any specific numbers, but I can tell you that in 2 years, this will be a 3-digit number in terms of revenues, India, China together.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO and MD
promises.actual: Target period of 2 years (Aug 2027) not yet reached

deliveredSummary: Management met Q4 FY26 growth targets, but missed FY26 EBITDA margin promises (19% vs 21% target). Profitability eroded further in FY27 with EBITDA margins falling to 15-16% alongside steep net profit YoY declines.

divergences.story: Management highlights strategic investments, AI transformation, and cautiously optimistic growth prospects.
divergences.numbers: Net profit fell 32.6% YoY in Jun 2026 and 28.4% YoY in Sep 2026.

divergences.story: Management spoke of maintaining margin stability amidst uncertainties.
divergences.numbers: EBITDA margins declined from 21% in Dec 2024 to 15% in Jun 2026.

bull: Delivered robust cash flow from operations of Rs 1,195 crore in FY26.
Strong cumulative 5-year cash conversion ratio of 165% of net profits.
Off-highway and commercial vehicle segment grew 27% YoY in Q2 FY27 per management.
bear: EBITDA margins compressed significantly to 15.0% in Jun 2026 and 16.0% in Sep 2026.
Net profit contracted YoY for five consecutive quarters up to Sep 2026.
Missed 21% full-year EBITDA margin target for FY26, reporting only 19.0%.
business: KPIT Technologies is a global technology company providing embedded software, AI, and digital solutions for the mobility industry, aiding leapfrog shifts toward autonomous, clean, smart, and connected vehicles.

threads.note: Management targeted 21% EBITDA margin on both calls, but actual FY26 margin landed at 19.0% and slid further in FY27.
